column12: THIS IS THE WEAKEST ASSET-LEVEL NUMBER IN THIS FILE and it reads generous. At 0.0576 the implied median time on drug is 11.7 years, which no study on file supports; NMOSD is a lifelong disease and the N-MOmentum open-label extension ran four years, not eleven. Two things push the measured ratio up. The population is still growing (52, 106, 158, 201 beneficiaries), and a patient in their first year receives three 300 mg infusions rather than two, so first-year patients lift mg per beneficiary above a maintenance year; against that, a mid-year start lowers it. Arithmetic on 2024: if the 141 beneficiaries carried from 2023 each took a full 600 mg, that is 84,600 of the 113,656 units, leaving 484 mg each for 60 new starters, which is consistent and implies the continuing cohort is near-complete. What would replace this: a published Uplizna persistence or discontinuation rate from a US claims cohort, which was searched for and not found

(2) The proliferative classes are 57.7% of biopsy-proven lupus nephritis: Wang H, Ren YL, Chang J, Gu L, Sun LY, Arch Rheumatol 2017;33(1):17-25, doi 10.5606/ArchRheumatol.2017.6127, PMID 29900975, a meta-analysis of 19 studies from 14 countries, reports class III at 11.2% to 24.2% (midpoint 17.7%) and pools class IV at 40% (95% CI 33 to 47). (3) The inadequate-response share is taken at 20%: Yo JH, Barbour TD, Nicholls K, Open Access Rheumatol 2019;11:179-188, doi 10.2147/OARRR.S166303, states that 'between 20% and 70% of patients with LN are reported to be refractory to standard immunosuppressive therapy'. 0.3547 x 0.577 x 0.20 = 0.04093, about 8,360 prevalent patients and 584 a year

column11: a judgement, and the competitive case is specific. Active proliferative lupus nephritis gained a third and then a fourth approved agent while this programme was running: belimumab (2020) and voclosporin (2021), and then obinutuzumab, an anti-CD20 B-cell depleter, which FDA approved on 2025-10-20 for adults with active lupus nephritis on standard therapy on the strength of REGENCY, 271 patients with ISN/RPS 2003 class III or IV with or without class V and complete renal response of 46.4% against 33.1% (Roche investor update, 2025-10-20). That is the same histological population and the same broad mechanism inebilizumab would enter against, from a company that can dose twice yearly after the first year. Rituximab is also used off-label in this setting. A tenth of the refractory proliferative pool is what a fourth or fifth B-cell agent entering last, on Phase 2 data, is put at
column12: a judgement that nothing resolves except years of sales, so no replacement clause is offered. The case for higher: an anti-CD19 antibody depletes plasmablasts that anti-CD20 agents spare, which is the mechanistic argument for using it after obinutuzumab rather than instead of it, and the pool here is already cut to refractory patients. The case for lower: CD19 CAR-T is being tested in the same refractory population and would take the sickest patients
